description: Checks an IPv4 address against the Blocklist.de 'all' list of IPs reported for attacks such as failed logins, SSH and mail abuse (about 24,000 addresses). A hit means it was reported recently; the list keeps only current reports. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_blocklist_de
title: Security Blocklist De
